howItWorks.heading: How the assistant will work
howItWorks.lead: Below is how the product is designed. It is in development, so every block is marked “soon”. Real dashboard screenshots will appear together with the product — we don’t pass drawings off as screenshots.

steps.title: Site address and ownership verification
steps.text: You add the site in the Telegram dashboard and confirm it is yours: a DNS record, a file at the site root or a meta tag. Each host separately: a subdomain is not considered verified just because the main domain is.

steps.title: The assistant reads the site
steps.text: Public pages are crawled via the sitemap and links, respecting robots.txt. On top of that — documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT) and your own answers to frequent questions.

steps.title: Appearance
steps.text: Colour, logo, assistant name, screen corner, greeting and suggestions — in the dashboard configurator.

steps.title: One line of code
steps.text: A loader tag on your site. The loader is light and starts after your page; the chat window loads only after a click.

steps.title: Conversations and leads
steps.text: Visitors ask questions, the assistant answers with a link to the source, and the contact details of those who agreed to leave them arrive in your Telegram.

reads.text: Your site’s public pages — re-crawled regularly; frequency depends on the plan.
Documents you upload and manual answers to frequent questions.
Never a private area: an admin panel is connected separately, into its own knowledge base.

answers.text: Every answer links to the page the fact came from.
Numbers (prices, deadlines, amounts) are checked against the source; if it isn’t in the knowledge, it says “I don’t know” and offers to contact a person.
Answers in the language of the question.

human.text: When a visitor asks for a person or the assistant doesn’t know the answer, a conversation card arrives in your Telegram, and the visitor sees the operator’s reply in the widget.

need.text: Verify every host where the widget will run.
Paste one line of code — about ten minutes.

security.heading: Security and privacy
security.lead: How the product is designed for security. It is in development, so every point is marked “soon”: these are the requirements we are building it to, not a description of what already works.

siteNow.heading: This website — already today
siteNow.text: No advertising trackers and no third-party analytics scripts. Page views are counted by Vercel Web Analytics without cookies; page speed is collected by our own endpoint without a visitor identifier. There is one cookie — your language choice, and only after you change it.

items.title: The assistant says it is an AI
items.text: The “AI assistant · may make mistakes” label in the widget header cannot be turned off on any plan — as required by Article 50 of the EU AI Act.

items.title: Visitor data
items.text: Conversations are kept for 90 days by default (the customer can choose 30 to 365), leads for 180 days. IP addresses only as a hash with a daily salt. Visitors can delete their own conversation from the widget menu.

items.title: Roles: you are the controller, we are the processor
items.text: For your visitors’ data you are the controller and we are the processor. A data processing agreement (DPA) is part of connecting.

items.title: Isolation
items.text: Different customers’ knowledge never mixes, and within one customer the Admin knowledge is stored separately from the Site knowledge and never reaches visitors. This is checked by a test in every release.

items.title: Prompt-injection defences
items.text: Page and document text is data, not commands: the assistant does not follow instructions it finds on a page.

items.title: Ownership verification
items.text: The widget runs only on hosts you verified with a DNS record, a file or a meta tag. We don’t accept “verification by widget code”: anyone can paste someone else’s code.

items.title: Your API secrets
items.text: Keys for Admin mode are encrypted with a separate key and are not shown in the interface after saving.

open: The data storage region will be stated before launch.
The list of sub-processors and a downloadable DPA will appear with the paid launch.
A responsible-disclosure contact (security.txt) will appear together with the domain.
security.wording: We don’t write “guaranteed” or “impossible to hack”: we describe how the system is designed and how that is tested.

pricing.dialogText: A dialog is a visitor session with at least one reply from the assistant; it closes after {idle} minutes of silence. A very long dialog counts as several: over {two} replies counts as 2, over {three} as 3.
pricing.overageText: By default, a soft stop: instead of answers the visitor sees a lead form, so your site is never left without the assistant. Optionally, extra dialogs from {minOverage} per dialog. On Trial — a stop.

faq.heading: Questions and answers
faq.lead: The answers describe how the product is designed. It is in development — anything that doesn’t work yet is marked “soon”.

items.a: Indicatively from {startPrice} a month for {startDialogs} dialogs; Trial is {trialDays} days free. Prices are confirmed at launch; payment is in Ukrainian hryvnia at the exchange rate or with Telegram Stars. Pilot users get 2 months free.

items.q: What happens when the dialogs run out?
items.a: By default, a lead form replaces the answers, so your site is never left without the assistant. You can switch on extra dialogs from {minOverage} per dialog.

items.q: Why do I need to verify site ownership?
items.a: So that nobody can put the assistant on someone else’s site in your name or read someone else’s pages as their own. Verification is a DNS record, a file or a meta tag.

items.q: I have several subdomains. Do I verify each one?
items.a: Yes, every host where the widget will run is verified separately.

items.q: Where does the assistant get its answers?
items.a: From your website’s public pages, uploaded documents and your answers to frequent questions. Every answer links to its source.

items.q: What if it gets something wrong?
items.a: The assistant doesn’t invent what isn’t in its knowledge: it says “I don’t know” and offers to contact a person. A wrong answer can be corrected in the dashboard.

items.q: Which languages does it answer in?
items.a: In the language of the visitor’s question.
For visitor data you are the controller and we are the processor; a data processing agreement (DPA) is part of connecting. The assistant always says it is an AI.

items.q: Can a visitor delete their conversation?
items.a: Yes, with a button in the widget menu.

items.q: Can the assistant work inside our admin panel?
items.a: Yes, as a staff assistant: following internal guidelines, with a separate knowledge base that never overlaps with the public one. Reading — Business and above; actions — Pro only and only with confirmation.

items.q: How do I install the assistant?
items.a: Paste one line of code on your site. There will be step-by-step guides for WordPress, Shopify, Horoshop, Tilda, GTM and React.
Yes, on the Business and Pro plans — in the stages after the first version.
2 months of free use for 3–5 websites. In return — access to conversations to check quality, under a data processing agreement. You can apply right now.
